sentence: This project builds a service center that gives researchers equipment and trained staff for cryo-electron tomography of specimens.
This project builds methods and a planning system for radiotherapy that combines proton and photon treatment for cancer.
This project continues a long-term family cohort to study breast cancer, including who is at risk, outcomes and survival.
This project studies how mutations in RNA binding proteins affect mRNA transport and local translation in neurons.
This project tries to find out how cells in plant meristems divide and decide what type of cell to become.
This project studies how immune checkpoint inhibitors used in cancer treatment lead to myocarditis in mouse models and how to reduce it.
This project studies how epigenetic regulation in bile duct cells leads to scarring in the liver.
This project builds AI tools that use patient health records to help decide how to use limited healthcare resources for type 2 diabetes.
This project studies how a type of ion channel is regulated by different stimuli and protein phosphorylation.
This project tries to find out which signaling networks drive the growth of cells in fibrolamellar carcinoma, a type of liver cancer.
This project builds small molecules that impair the function of fusion oncoproteins, which drive pediatric and adolescent cancer.
This project supports a birth cohort that studies how airway epithelial development and respiratory syncytial virus infection in infancy relate to childhood asthma.
This project determines atomic structures of membrane-interacting domains of a viral fusion protein and tests their roles in viral infection.
This project studies whether methamphetamine use increases virus production and inflammation in people with HIV taking antiretroviral therapy.
This project builds a hamster model that can be infected with hepatitis B virus, to support work on cures.
This project studies how vesicular trafficking in neutrophils and their precursors drives inflammation in coronary artery disease.
This project uses imaging mass spectrometry to map metabolic changes in muscle, fat and liver tissue during cancer cachexia.
This project tries to find out how prophages in the gut affect the production of a broad-spectrum antimicrobial.
This project studies how bacteria recognize and transport sterols, including in pathogens and the gut microbiome.
This project moves an ultra-compact sample prep platform into manufacturing, working on product quality, cost and production capacity.
